posts.title: Welcome to GhostFx Static Migration
posts.html:
Welcome to GhostFx

GhostFx is a C# .NET solution for converting Ghost blog posts to Markdown formatted for Docfx static site generation.

2 Key Features
  • Frontmatter extraction (slug, tags, date, SEO)
  • Drafts vs published articles separation
  • Tag taxonomy indexes
  • Theme downloading & code injection extraction
